full_prompt_en: The image is a square black-and-white archival film still of a bowler-hatted man seated among a small group. He sits in the center foreground, facing the camera directly with both hands resting on his knees. His dark rounded hat, curly hair at the temples, darkened eye sockets, and tiny rectangular mustache make the pale face stand out against a dark jacket. Under the jacket are a patterned vest, shirt, and dark tie, rendered in several middle grays rather than flat black. His serious, almost puzzled expression becomes the focal point. Behind him, a woman in a broad dark hat and pale scarf sits at the upper left, slightly out of focus. A man in a dark cap and coat stands in the shadow behind the central hat, and a younger woman in a decorated dark headpiece and necklace sits at upper right looking down. Parts of other figures and hanging fabric are cropped by the left and right edges. The group is compressed into a shallow interior or set-like space of dark vertical forms and indistinct objects. The camera is level with the seated man, and his upper body occupies nearly the full height of the lower frame. Soft frontal light reveals his pale hands and face; darker recesses behind the group maintain depth, while highlights on collars, jewelry, and fabric edges punctuate the shadows. The film image has visible grain, slight blur in secondary faces, and gentle tonal roll-off around fine details. The whole composition feels intimate and theatrical, using layered gazes, dense grayscale clothing, and the stark central face to hold a still moment.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一张方形黑白档案电影画面：一位戴圆顶礼帽的男子坐在一小群人前。他坐在中央前景，正对镜头，双手搁在膝上。深色圆帽、鬓边卷发、变暗的眼窝和小小的矩形胡须，使浅色面孔从暗外套前凸出。外套里是有花纹的马甲、衬衫和暗领带，以几层中灰而非纯黑呈现。他严肃而略带困惑的表情成为焦点。其后，左上方一位戴宽暗帽、围浅围巾的女子坐着，稍稍失焦。一位戴暗便帽、穿大衣的男子立在中央帽子后方的阴影中；右上方一位戴装饰暗头饰与项链的年轻女子坐着，低头看向下方。其他人的局部和垂挂布料被左右画边裁掉。众人挤进由暗色竖向形体和模糊物件组成的浅室内或布景空间。相机与坐着的男子平视，他的上身几乎占满下半画幅的高度。柔和正面光照出浅手与脸；人群后的暗凹处维持纵深，领口、首饰和布边上的亮点刺破阴影。电影画面有可见颗粒，次要面孔略糊，细部周围的明暗过渡柔和。整体构图亲密而有戏剧感，以层叠的目光、密集灰阶衣装和醒目的中央浅脸留住静止一刻。
style_prompt_en: Archival black-and-white photographic texture combines close level framing with densely layered grayscale forms. A pale central opening is surrounded by near-black masses and background recesses, while smaller silvery accents mark edges and material changes. Soft frontal light gives the primary area clear detail; secondary layers recede through blur and lower contrast. Film grain, slight tonal softness, and imperfect sharpness preserve an early-cinema feel. Dark vertical structures behind the focal zone compress depth, and cropped side forms make the frame feel crowded. The rhythm is still and theatrical, built from repeated pale accents and overlapping silhouettes rather than strong movement.
style_prompt_zh: 档案式黑白摄影肌理把贴近的平视裁幅与密集层叠的灰阶形体结合。中央一处浅色开口被近黑色块与背景暗凹处围住，较小银色点缀标出边缘和材质变化。柔和正面光让主要区域细节清楚；次要层次因模糊与较低反差退后。胶片颗粒、轻微调子柔化与不完美锐度保留早期电影气息。焦点后方的暗色竖向结构压缩纵深，侧边被裁形体使画幅显得拥挤。节奏静止而有戏剧感，由重复的浅色点缀和交叠剪影而非强动作搭起。
theme_en: A bowler-hatted man seated among a small group in an old film still
theme_zh: 戴圆顶礼帽的男子坐在旧电影画面中的一小群人前
name: D. W. Griffith
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
